up: List the compounds mentioned in document CHEMBL5726589, showing their ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES. The document is identified by its chembl_id in the docs table. Compounds are linked to documents via compound_records (doc_id). Retrieve each distinct compound by joining docs -> compound_records on doc_id -> molecule_dictionary on molregno -> compound_structures on molregno. Output the compound's ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id) and canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles). Include all compounds associated with that document.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5726589';
